interpretations.meaning: A sign relation is triadic: a sign-vehicle represents an object through an interpretant, so interpretation is constitutive of signification.
A linguistic sign joins a signifier with a signified; their connection is treated as arbitrary and meaning is constituted through differences within the language system.
A sign functioning through a shared quality or resemblance with its object.
A sign functioning through an existential, physical, or causal connection with its object.
A sign functioning through a general, conventional, habitual, or rule-governed connection with its object.
The dimension of semiotic concerned with relations among signs abstracted from their relations to objects or interpreters.
The dimension of semiotic concerned with relations of signs to what they designate or denote.
The dimension of semiotic concerned with relations of signs to their interpreters.
